extDescription.message: Detects and downloads DRM-free videos from the pages you visit.

popupEmpty.message: No videos found on this page

popupRestricted.message: Chrome does not allow extensions on this page

popupDetectFailed.message: Could not look for videos in this tab. Try again.

errorCandidateNotFound.message: Video not found. Reopen the popup and try again.

errorProtected.message: This video is DRM-protected and cannot be downloaded.

errorUnsupported.message: This kind of video is not supported yet.

accessNeeded.message: This page has players on other sites:

accessDenied.message: Access not granted. Videos from those sites will not be detected.

hlsErrorFetch.message: Could not read this video's playlist.

hlsErrorParse.message: This video's playlist is not valid.

hlsErrorGeneric.message: Could not read the playlist. Reopen the popup and try again.

jobErrorFETCH_FAILED.message: Could not download every part of the video. Try again.

jobErrorTOO_LARGE.message: The video is too large to assemble (1.5 GB limit).

jobErrorUNSUPPORTED_CODEC.message: This video uses an audio or video format that is not supported yet.

jobErrorASSEMBLY_FAILED.message: Could not assemble the video file.

jobErrorDOWNLOAD_FAILED.message: Chrome could not save the file.

jobErrorENCRYPTED.message: This video is encrypted and cannot be downloaded.

errorHlsNotResolved.message: Could not read this video's playlist. Reopen the popup and try again.

errorJobRunning.message: This video is already being downloaded.

errorTooManyJobs.message: There are already 2 downloads in progress. Wait for one to finish.

audioIncluded.description: Note on the HLS card when the download will merge a separate audio track

relatedSources.description: Summary of the collapsed list of redundant sources under the main card

audioLabel.description: Label of the audio track selector of the HLS card
